description: Approved local-only release policy for the ESP32-C3 Plane Radar firmware. scripts/build-release.ps1 and scripts/verify-release.ps1 both load this file; it is the single tracked source of truth for the pinned toolchain, the five release environments, their EXACT approved resource/file sizes, the required source gates, and the default-artifact identity. Any intentional change to an approved size or pin MUST edit this tracked file in the same commit.

local_only.note: The repository is intentionally remote-free. Release artifacts stay local and ignored under release/.

tests.native_test_summary: 606 cases across 41 suite runs (native 580/39 + native-diag 5/1 + native-gfx 21/1)
tests.note: build-release records manifest.tests.native_test = native_test_summary and gates_run=true; verify-release checks manifest.tests.native_test equals this string and gates_run is true.

default_artifact.note: supermini/firmware-merged.bin is the ONLY default release image. It is flashed at offset 0x0.

required_source_gates.summary: 606 cases across 41 suite runs (native 580/39 + native-diag 5/1 + native-gfx 21/1); also runs verify-airport-data and verify-egress-policy fail-fast.
SnapshotStoreTestAccess friend seam cannot leak into a firmware build (source + live compile check).
Offline CA trust gate: 4 pinned roots, no setInsecure, CA enforced, derived-time clock, CA-authenticated cert-notBefore floor.
8 static provisioning release invariants (no WiFiManager/OTA/mDNS, closed route set, no permanent listener, no secret logging, one framebuffer, bounded portal).
10 worker source invariants + Phase 10 diag env matrix (17 tamper cases).

merged_layout.description: Byte-exact layout of every env's firmware-merged.bin (the SHIPPED/flashed image). build-release and verify-release re-derive these invariants directly from the packaged merged bytes (binary-safe) and NEVER trust merge.log text. The three components below are board/framework artifacts and are byte-identical across all five envs; the app region is byte-for-byte equal to that env's firmware.bin.
merged_layout.note: app_offset 65536 = 0x10000; bootloader 0x0, partitions 0x8000, boot_app0 0xe000. merged length MUST equal app_offset + firmware.bin length; the region at app_offset MUST equal firmware.bin byte-for-byte; every gap between a component end and the next offset MUST be gap_fill_byte (0xFF).

proof_invariants_note: The per-environment binary proof spec (worker/diag/heap symbol + logging-string invariants AND the firmware-merged.bin layout invariants: component SHA-256 at fixed offsets, app-region byte-equality to firmware.bin, exact merged length, and 0xFF gap fill) is centrally defined in scripts/release-common.ps1 (Get-ProofSpec / Get-BinaryProofInvariants) and re-derived byte-for-byte identically by build-release and verify-release. It binds the EXACT current-head binaries only and does not claim raw equivalence to any prior phase. The exact firmware.bin / firmware-merged.bin SHA-256 anchors (environments[].sha256) and merged_layout are the tracked external anchors: the shipped merged image is bound to tracked policy + the app, not to self-consistent manifest hashes.
